creativeThesis: Keep one chocolate specimen recognizable while exposing two distinct levels of its structure.

decisions.treatment: Original authored 3D material cutaway with explicitly schematic analytical insets

decisions.rationale: Material identity supports the unchanged-recipe contrast while analytical abstraction remains legible.
decisions.treatment: Contemporary material study: rich cocoa object on quiet smoky-lilac field; analytical insets are matte pale-lilac. No museum workbench, kitchen tutorial or luxury-ad montage.

decisions.rationale: Sequential object and two-scale views limit mobile cognitive load.
decisions.treatment: One centrally dominant floating slab; one analytical region at a time. Persistent ingredient key identifies fat phase and irregular solid particles. Separate bounded inset distinguishes crystal arrangement from the larger network.

decisions.rationale: Approved comprehension distinguishes fat from solids and arrangement from network without invented microscopy.
decisions.treatment: Clearly labeled SIMPLIFIED EXPLANATORY MODEL. Keep sugar/cocoa solids present and visually distinct as fat ordering changes. Use local packing motifs only as symbols of arrangements; larger neighboring crystal domains show network separately. No Form V/VI labels or exact unit cells.

decisions.rationale: Humanist sentence-case clarity pairs with the dense mechanistic explanation; no historical font inherited.
decisions.treatment: One humanist sans family with double-storey letterforms; sentence-case regular/medium captions, semibold short labels. Avoid decorative serif, huge stacked numerical headings and all-caps shouted captions. Exact font files/weights/license to be pinned after direction approval, no system fallback.

decisions.rationale: Speech-first complete wording and small selective emphasis preserve qualification without covering structure.
decisions.treatment: Full exact narration in natural spoken phrases, stable dedicated lower reading area with restrained opacity transitions and no karaoke bounce/backplate by default. Protect can/enough/helps. Analytical disclosure uses separate persistent label, never competes with captions.

decisions.rationale: Established af_heart primary policy; no story-specific material reason to deviate.
decisions.treatment: Kokoro af_heart under existing primary narrator policy; conversational precise delivery, no auditions or generated audio.

decisions.rationale: Tactility serves the material payoff while silence avoids asserting crystal sounds.
decisions.treatment: Voice-led, no continuous music bed. Sparse original handling/soft flow accents at object-scale transitions; one illustrative dry fracture accent at payoff outside words. Analytical views mostly silent; no audible molecular activity or real-experiment implication.

decisions.rationale: No room setting exists to justify a continuous ambient bed.
decisions.treatment: No continuous room/kitchen ambience; absence of bed keeps structure legible.

decisions.rationale: Thirty-five to forty-one seconds of explanation needs space for voice and structural distinctions; independent choice, not universal rule.
decisions.treatment: Recommend no music for this specific short; silence, sparse original tonal music and tactile-only mixes considered. Any later switch remains a considered story choice, not universal policy.

decisions.rationale: Use approved words and later measured voice/comprehension pauses, not monetization or legacy duration.
decisions.treatment: Exact 80 words; allow arrangement/network distinction to register. Editorial 35–41.3 second estimate, later measured audio determines authored timing; no threshold padding.

decisions.rationale: Stable axes preserve identity through object-to-model-to-object transitions.
decisions.treatment: Mostly stable near-orthographic three-quarter external view; analytical windows flatten frontally. Small purposeful approach for internal distinction, never camera flying through molecules.

decisions.rationale: Material surface and visibly abstract internal view have different representational purposes.
decisions.treatment: Broad soft key on object creates a controlled highlight; analytical model has flat illumination and deliberate visible abstraction. Same lighting across possible outcome comparison; gloss is not a crystal-form diagnosis.

decisions.rationale: Original material appearance provides tangible context without false microscopy.
decisions.treatment: Cocoa surface with restrained realistic sheen and original roughness variation; abstract fat/solid regions matte and diagrammatic. No photoreal generated microscopy.

decisions.rationale: State changes remain causal and maintain particle identity.
decisions.treatment: Section opening reveals fat/solids; analytical window expands along a stable axis; state changes dissolve/rebuild the fat structure while solid-particle identities persist; inset retracts to same specimen for payoff.

decisions.rationale: Avoid both literal simulation claims and gratuitous spectacle.
decisions.treatment: Deliberate settling of schematic domains, not random Brownian swarm or explosive lattice collapse. Only the fat structure changes through sufficient melt; placement indicates possible configurations, not measured kinetics.

decisions.rationale: Exact approved possibility hook resolves through structure, without inventing an experiment.
decisions.treatment: Same generic recipe shown as one labeled ingredient identity beside two possible material outcomes; small difference in flex/fracture/readable surface, labeled conceptual comparison. No fake kitchen test.

decisions.rationale: Return mechanism to familiar fracture/gloss without claiming a unique polymorph.
decisions.treatment: Return from model to intact object, show schematic controlled fracture and clean surface highlight; same-recipe label persists while internal structure resolves. Same recipe/different structure remains visible, not perfect crystal claim.

decisions.rationale: Predicted mobile comprehension is not device evidence; master, variant and presentation surface remain separate.
decisions.treatment: Short-form composition with generous central subject region and dedicated caption reading area; no exact native crop/UI geometry assumed. Covers/variants/deliveries and real-device QA occur later, separately.

emotionalTarget: Quiet tactile curiosity becoming a precise aha; no shock, confectionery temptation montage or false laboratory authority.

ownerReview.rationale: Owner explicitly requests CreativeDirection approval. Original material-cutaway medium, two-scale model and story-specific caption/sound treatment need acceptance before any production planning.

provenance.notes: Revision 1 owner-approved without creative changes. Revision 2 records readiness and exact decision-entry binding; one candidate only, no platform/publication approval.

viewerExperience: A familiar chocolate bar becomes a material you can understand: the ingredients stay recognizable while hidden organization changes, then the explanation returns to snap and surface.
visualThesis: Keep the ingredient identity constant; open a clearly schematic view of cocoa-butter structure, distinguish packing from network, and resolve the resulting material behavior.
